severance.statement: The Acanthian Dove Room must not be used as a surrogate anchor for Ichabod-class material. The Dove Room governs transmission under hostile conditions; the Ichabod Chamber governs paradox containment. These functions are structurally incompatible.
severance.consequence: The locus standing HISTORICAL / ANCHOR-GAP records a declared severance, not an unrepaired defect. The gap is the correct state.
